WITH per_media_type AS (
    SELECT
        mt.Name AS media_type_name,
        AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond
    FROM Track AS t
    JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
    GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
)
SELECT
    media_type_name,
    avg_bytes_per_millisecond,
    avg_bytes_per_millisecond - AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) OVER () AS above_overall_average
FROM per_media_type
WHERE avg_bytes_per_millisecond > AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) OVER ()
